description: Find the projects, tasks and subtasks in your organization where time can be tracked. Pass a name fragment as query to search customer, project, task and subtask names at once: every matching subtask comes back in `matches` with its full path (customer > project > task > subtask) and its subtask_id. Use this to locate where to record work. Returns ids and names only.

max_results.description: Optional maximum number of rows to return (1-50, default 50).

project_id.description: Optional project id to drill into. When supplied, returns that project's tasks and subtasks.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive name fragment. It matches customer, project, task and subtask names: `projects` lists the projects whose own name or customer's name matches, and `matches` lists every subtask whose own name or task's name matches, with its full path and subtask_id. With project_id, it filters that project's tasks and returns that project's matching subtasks in `matches`.

name: find_billing_work
